status: declared exact integer tables for the product check
note: The expected product is recorded so a reader can check the arithmetic without running the checker. The checker recomputes the product from the declared tables AND compares it to this recorded field as a regression cross-check. Agreement is not evidence of correctness: a wrong expectation together with a wrong computation would also agree. The substantive falsifier remains the internal consistency between realize(A) . realize(B) and the ordinary matrix product.
